author: spencer_tb
content:
🐐  `bogoat-devnet@v2.0.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-bogota-devnet@v2.0.0

EELS branch: [`devnets/bogota/2`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/bogota/2)
Test release tracker: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3889

**EIP-8253:** read the account list from the chain config ([`zeroNonceStorageAccounts`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/ca8c60947b8b1541d9278bdc9a4d100287f033f9/packages/testing/src/execution_testing/fixtures/blockchain.py#L938)) instead of hardcoding it per chain ID. Each fixture sets its own list there, so a client that doesn't bump those accounts fails the tests.
